newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.02 down at 42 to the dollar in the kerb market on Wednesday amid a rise in demand for dollars, dealers said.
They said the rupee might fall further on Thursday as supply of the dollar from abroad was slow because of the year-end holiday season.
The State (central) Bank rates remained unchaged at 40.1200/ 40.3206 rupees to the dollar to the dollar set on October 22.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 5.0 percent.
